title: Dévissage des complexes ½ simpliciaux ∂ - parfaits et structures multiplicatives… (1975 ou 1976) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting, from the neighbouring pages. Grothendieck works with an additive 'universal' category 𝒫 of Σ-modules (sub-cases P_0, Q). These are presumably functors on a category Σ of finite ordinals and injections, appropriate to semi-simplicial ('½ simpliciaux') objects. 𝒫 carries an exactness notion ('Σ-mono', 'Σ-cart.' = left exact). It contains a class 𝕂 of 'injective-type' objects, and every L in 𝒫 has a resolution 0→L→I→J with I, J in 𝕂.

The previous page sets up a correspondence: a (semi-)cosimplicial or cochain complex C^· in a tensor abelian category ℬ is the same as a Σ-cartesian functor F = F_C : 𝒫 → ℬ. Such a functor is determined by its restriction to 𝕂. Under this dictionary Ψ^0 corresponds to the degree-0 cocycles: F(Ψ^0) ≅ Z^0(C^·) = Ker(∂^0 : C^0 → C^1).

This page has four steps.
(1) Computing F off 𝕂. Using two-term 𝕂-resolutions, F(X) ≃ R^0F(L) ≃ Ker(F(I) → F(J)). So F is the right Kan extension (R^0) of F|𝕂.
(2) Multiplication. Suppose a multiplicative structure F(I)⊗F(J) → F(I*J) is given on 𝕂 (F|𝕂 lax monoidal for a tensor product * of Σ-modules). One wants to extend it to F(X)⊗F(Y) → F(X*Y) by the square: left vertical F(X)⊗F(Y) → F(I_X)⊗F(I_Y); bottom the given structure; right vertical F(X*Y) → F(I_X*I_Y).
(3) Uniqueness. The key input is that * of two complexes of Σ-monos (resolutions) is again a complex of Σ-monos, said to follow 'immediately from the Dold–Puppe formulas' (Eilenberg–Zilber type). So I_X*I_Y begins a resolution of X*Y. Since F is left exact, the right vertical arrow is a mono, and the dotted arrow is uniquely determined. Existence follows because the composite is killed by the next differential, by Leibniz.
(4) Axioms. Naturality in each factor, associativity and commutativity are claimed immediate, by uniqueness and transport from 𝕂. The only non-formal axiom is the unit. It means giving a map B' : 𝟙 → F(Ψ_0) ≅ Z^0(C^·), i.e. a unit landing in the 0-cocycles. The axiom says the unit is compatible with the 'h-⊗-algebra' structure that Ψ^0 inherits from 𝕂.

The marginal NB stresses two points: one needs the existence of Ker(∂^0 : C^0 → C^1) in ℬ, and a map 𝟙_ℬ → C^0 factoring through it.

Purpose (next page). Every 'universal' construction in the model category 𝒫 that uses only h-injectivity and ⊗-structures transfers to any C^· carrying such a multiplicative structure. Example: the projective resolution C^·_* * C^·_* of the unit maps to the h-injective C^·_*, giving a product C^·⊗_ℬ C^· → C^·. This product is defined up to homotopy and is associative, commutative and unital up to homotopy, so C^· becomes a homotopy ⊗-algebra and H^*(C^·) a graded-commutative algebra.

The whole is a 'representability' approach to cup products: a complex is a left-exact functor on a universal category, and multiplicative structures are lax-monoidal structures on that functor, extended from injectives by left exactness.
errors: Notational clash: I, J denote the two terms of one resolution (0→L→I→J, previous page), but in the square F(I)⊗F(J)→F(I*J) they evidently stand for resolving objects of X and Y respectively (I_X, I_Y).
The left vertical arrow is labelled 'B' as if it were the structure map; really the structure map B is the bottom arrow on 𝕂, and the left vertical is just the tensor of the inclusions.

Existence of the factorization is not spelled out. One needs the image of F(X)⊗F(Y) in F(I_X*I_Y) to be killed by the differential to the next term of the resolution of X*Y (J_X*I_Y ⊕ I_X*J_Y). This is true by the Leibniz rule but is left implicit.

'Immediate' associativity and commutativity rely on the analogous uniqueness for triple products and on * being symmetric monoidal compatibly with Σ-monos. Plausible, but unchecked; sign issues are flagged only on the next page.

ideas.what: Representing a (semi-)cosimplicial/cochain complex in an abelian category ℬ as a left-exact functor from a universal category of Σ-modules, determined by its values on injective-type objects via R^0 / two-term resolutions
ideas.modern_name: Left-exact (right Kan) extension from injectives; Dold–Kan-type universal property of complexes
ideas.usually_credited_to: Dold–Kan correspondence (Dold, Kan 1958); extension of additive functors via resolutions is standard homological algebra
ideas.where_published: Similar spirit to the Tohoku paper (1957) and to Les Dérivateurs, but this specific universal Σ-module framework is not known in print

ideas.what: Extending a multiplicative (lax monoidal) structure from 𝕂 to all of 𝒫, uniquely, using that the tensor product * preserves resolutions (Dold–Puppe formulas) and that F is left exact
ideas.modern_name: Lax monoidal structure on a Kan extension; Day convolution / Eilenberg–Zilber
ideas.usually_credited_to: Day (1970) for convolution; Eilenberg–Zilber, Dold–Puppe (1961) for tensor products of simplicial objects

ideas.what: Reduction of all algebra axioms to the unit axiom: the unit must be a map 𝟙 → Z^0(C^·) compatible with the 'h-⊗-algebra' structure on Ψ^0
ideas.modern_name: Unit of a dg/cosimplicial algebra landing in 0-cocycles

ideas.what: Transfer of homotopy-coherent multiplicative structures from a universal model to arbitrary complexes in a tensor abelian category, yielding a product C⊗C→C associative, commutative and unital up to homotopy (next page)
ideas.modern_name: Operadic / E∞ structures on cochains; homotopy commutative dg-algebras in tensor categories

missed.claim: Grothendieck sketches a programme to obtain homotopy-commutative multiplicative structures on complexes in an arbitrary abelian ⊗-category. Complexes are encoded as left-exact functors on a universal Σ-module category, and products come from a lax monoidal structure extended from injectives. The resulting structure is unique, and the unit axiom is the only non-formal condition. It anticipates the 'universal model + transfer' approach to E∞ structures on cochains, but was never written up.
missed.quote: Or on voit que * transforme des complexes de Σ-monos en un complexe de Σ-monos (résulte immédiatement des formules de Dold Puppe) donc la 2ème flèche verticale est un mono, d'où la détermination unique de ?.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Gives an elementary, functor-of-points style uniqueness argument for cup-product structures in general tensor abelian categories, e.g. for motivic or perfect complexes. It sits close to later operadic work (Hinich–Schechtman, Mandell) without operads; the historical priority is undocumented.

deep.surprise_reason: A coherent but sketchy unpublished framework for multiplicative structures on complexes via a universal Σ-module category, prefiguring later E∞/operadic transfer ideas. The individual steps (Kan extension along resolutions, Eilenberg–Zilber) are standard, and the page is fragmentary, so it is notable mainly as undocumented context.
